name: Song of the Shield Wall

automation.text: You begin a chant that is magically accompanied by the clanging sound of hammers against iron. Glowing, spectral, circular shields appear before a number of creatures equal to your spellcasting ability modifier who are within 30 feet of you. Each creature gains a +2 bonus to their AC.

description: You begin a chant that is magically accompanied by the clanging sound of hammers against iron. Glowing, spectral, circular shields appear before a number of creatures equal to your spellcasting ability modifier who are within 30 feet of you. Each creature gains a +2 bonus to their AC.
higherlevels: If you cast this spell with a 6th level spell slot, the bonus to AC increased to +3, and if you use an 8th level spell slot, it increases to +4.
